result.instructions: Tools for SimpleTexting, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SimpleTexting data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run simpletexting_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simpletexting_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simpletexting_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. simpletexting_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simpletexting_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the account's contacts as a paged collection, optionally filtered by a `since` cursor and sort `direction`. SimpleTexting REST: GET /contacts.

since.description: Return contacts created/updated since this cursor or timestamp.

tools.name: simpletexting_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by its id or phone number, including profile fields, list memberships, and custom fields. SimpleTexting REST: GET /contacts/{contactIdOrNumber}.

tools.name: simpletexting_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the account's campaigns as a paged collection, optionally filtered by sending number, state, list, and start-date range. Note: only immediate campaigns are returned — scheduled/recurring campaigns are NOT included. SimpleTexting REST: GET /campaigns.

accountPhone.description: Filter by the sending account phone number.

state.description: Filter by campaign state (e.g. SENT | SCHEDULED | DRAFT).

listNameOrId.description: Filter by recipient list name or id.

startDateFrom.description: Filter to campaigns starting on/after this date.

startDateTo.description: Filter to campaigns starting on/before this date.

tools.name: simpletexting_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: Get a single campaign by its id, including its message, recipients, and status. SimpleTexting REST: GET /campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: simpletexting_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List the account's messages as a paged collection (inbound + outbound message history). SimpleTexting REST: GET /messages.

tools.name: simpletexting_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: Get a single message by its id, including its text, direction, status, and timestamps. SimpleTexting REST: GET /messages/{id}.

tools.name: simpletexting_list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: List the account's media items (MMS assets) as a paged collection. SimpleTexting REST: GET /media.

tools.name: simpletexting_get_media
tools.title: Get media
tools.description: Get a single media item (MMS asset) by its id, including its URL and metadata. SimpleTexting REST: GET /media/{id}.

tools.name: simpletexting_evaluate_message
tools.title: Evaluate message
tools.description: DRY-RUN a message body to compute its segment count, whether it sends as SMS or MMS, and its estimated cost — WITHOUT sending anything. Safe and read-only. SimpleTexting REST: POST /messages/evaluate with JSON body {text, mode?}.

mode.description: Optional send mode to evaluate against (e.g. AUTO | SMS | MMS).

tools.name: simpletexting_send_message
tools.title: Send message
tools.description: SENDS A REAL SMS or MMS to a recipient — this MODIFIES live data and consumes message credits. Provide only the optional fields you need. SimpleTexting REST: POST /messages with JSON body {contactPhone, text, accountPhone?, mode?, subject?, fallbackText?, mediaItems?}.

contactPhone.description: Recipient phone number (E.164 or national format).

accountPhone.description: Sending account phone number — omit to use the account default.

mode.description: Send mode: AUTO | SMS | MMS | MMS_PREFERRED.

fallbackText.description: Fallback text if MMS cannot be delivered.

mediaItems.description: Media URLs or media ids to attach (makes it an MMS).

tools.name: simpletexting_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: UPDATES a live contact — its profile fields, list memberships, and custom fields. This MODIFIES live data. Provide only the fields you want to change. SimpleTexting REST: PUT /contacts/{contactIdOrNumber}.

contact.description: Contact id or phone number to update.

contactPhone.description: New phone number for the contact.

listIds.description: List ids or names to assign the contact to.

customFields.description: Custom field values, as a map of field name → value.
